classification.difficultyReason: Read the three-set Venn diagram, add the four Pilates regions, subtract from the total and simplify. The missing 'none' count is not needed. The demand matches p11-q10.

content.prompt:
A community centre surveyed 140 members about the classes they attend. The results are recorded in the Venn diagram below, although the number of members who attend none of the classes is missing.

If one of the members is selected at random, what is the probability that the member does not attend Pilates?

answer.worked: $\begin{aligned}\text{Members who attend Pilates} &= 25+9+8+4=46\\\text{Members who do not attend Pilates} &= 140-46=94\\P(\text{does not attend Pilates}) &= \frac{94}{140}=\frac{47}{70}\end{aligned}$
